objective: Correct the HTTPS connection deadline gap and redirect method rewriting found by independent VERIFY.

implementation.https_setup: Resolved TCP address attempts share the remaining monotonic budget; HTTPS recomputes and applies the remaining budget immediately before the TLS handshake.
implementation.dns_limit: Synchronous getaddrinfo cannot be safely cancelled with this standard-library transport. Resolution may exceed the deadline; after it returns, an expired deadline prevents TCP connection and HTTP request submission. A strict wall-clock bound is not claimed.
implementation.redirects: 301/302/303 rewrite POST to GET and discard its body headers. HEAD, DELETE, and other non-POST methods retain their method and body. 307/308 retain method and body. Authorization is still stripped across origins.
preserved_contracts: standard HTTPResponse parsing and normal urllib-compatible response shape
deadline enforcement for headers, response bodies, Content-Length, chunk framing, error bodies, redirects, and retries
request attempt accounting, including redirect hops
partial result persistence and incomplete/retryable completion semantics
